messages:
Sam (CedarPoint): Hi team, we're looking to onboard a custom invoice/claims parser (extract names, account numbers, payment card last4, amounts). Must run in our VPC/on-prem, full redaction for PCI data, and integrated audit logs. Renewal in 4 weeks so timeline tight. What do you need?

Nina (CSM): Thanks Sam. Quick check: is this model a fine-tune of an existing open model or proprietary from you? Also expected QPS/p95?

Sam (CedarPoint): It's a finetuned 3B transformer (PyTorch). Expected steady 50rps, spikes to 250rps during batch runs. p95 target ~250ms. We need deterministic PCI redaction + ability to opt-out for debug copies.

Ravi (Solutions Eng): For private deployment we'll need sample documents (can be redacted) + 300 labeled examples for the extractor to validate. Also, please confirm whether you want token/substring redaction or whole-field redaction (e.g., redact entire line containing card number).

Camille (Safety): For PCI we require deterministic redaction and retention policy: redaction must be irreversible in logs unless a key-controlled unredaction flow exists. We'll need dataset provenance: any card data in training set? Also request a policy for debug access and a small threat model.

Evan (Platform): Infrastructure notes: 3B model fits on 1x A40 comfortably with INT8. For burst to 250rps we'd recommend autoscaling group + warm standby. If strict p95 <250ms we might do qkv-cache tuning and request token length distribution.

Sam (CedarPoint): Training data did include masked card tokens but sometimes raw strings in older batches. We'll provide DPA and an anonymized sample set now. Prefer substring redaction (last4 kept masked or hashed).

Nina (CSM): I'll mark this high-priority in the account plan given renewal. Proposed schedule: Day 0 sign DPA/NDA, Day 1 safety intake, Day 2 infra provisioning, Day 3-4 perf & redaction tests, Day 7 go/no-go. Can we meet that?

Ravi (Solutions Eng): Parallelize safety intake and infra prep once DPA is in place. I can run an initial eval on 100 samples today if Sam uploads to the secure bucket.

Camille (Safety): We'll need the PCI taxonomy (PAN, CVV, expiry) + acceptable false-negative threshold. Also latency budget added: redaction should add <15ms median.

Sam (CedarPoint): Uploaded samples: s3://cedarpoint/onboard/claims_samples_120.jsonl. DPA uploaded to shared drive. Taxonomy: PAN, CVV, expiry, tokenized_account. FN tolerance: 0.5% for PAN.

OpsBot: Ticket CP-9201 created for onboarding. Assigned to Evan and Ravi.

Evan (Platform): Spun up dev cluster at https://vpc.redwood.local/cp-9201. Need access list for your engineers. Also request token length histogram to tune batching.

Ravi (Solutions Eng): Quick harness snippet pasted (Python):
```
from redwood import PrivateClient
cli = PrivateClient(endpoint='https://vpc.redwood.local', project='cedarpoint')
resp = cli.extract(model='cedarpoint-3b-invoice', docs=[...], redact='substring')
```
Use redact='substring' to exercise redaction flow.

Nina (CSM): Noting renewal risk: if we miss go-date we'll offer a 30-day hosted fall-back at discounted rate to keep them running. Looping Sales privately.

Sam (CedarPoint): Need per-call audit fields: model_version, redaction_rule_id, redaction_hash, requestor_id. Also encrypted blobs of raw if unredaction needed under legal process.

Camille (Safety): We'll allow unredaction only via HSM-protected key and documented legal workflow. Camille will draft redaction & unredaction policy v0.1 in 48h.

Ravi (Solutions Eng): Ran quick eval on the 120 samples: baseline F1 for PAN spans 98.7; int8 quantized drop to 97.9 after calibration. Sharing report in CP-9201.

Evan (Platform): Dev cluster ready. ETA for smoke perf tests 48h. Will tune batching once token histogram uploaded.

Sam (CedarPoint): Token histogram attached in bucket. Median 45 tokens, 95th 320. We'll add more long-form invoices if that helps.

Nina (CSM): Actions summary: 1) Sam confirm DPA (done) + upload labeled 300 ex (in progress) 2) Ravi run expanded eval (next 48h) 3) Camille produce redaction/unredaction policy (48h) 4) Evan complete perf tuning (48-72h) 5) Nina update renewal mitigation plan and communicate daily.

Sam (CedarPoint): Uploading labeled set now. Appreciate the fast turnaround. Renewal convo noted.

Ravi (Solutions Eng): Will share full eval and calibration notes in CP-9201 in 24h. Initial signs look promising for int8.

Camille (Safety): Draft policy shared: https://drive.redwood/safety/cedarpoint/redaction_policy_v0.1.md

OpsBot: CP-9201 status: dev-cluster-provisioned -> tests queued.

Evan (Platform): One more: if you require storing encrypted raw blobs for legal unredaction, we need KMS access details and retention TTL.

Sam (CedarPoint): KMS details shared in secure vault. Retention TTL 180 days.

Nina (CSM): Thanks everyone. We'll keep this thread as the daily status channel. Sam we'll ping you EOD with updates. :thumbsup:
